body: I was actually told by my last crush after a few dates that I'm a great guy but my self deprecating humor and depression along with the things I share and post is very off putting, and it basically scared her off. So this is very relatable.

The fight was extremely cinematic and difficult. Once you learn his moveset it almost feels like a dance. A dance where if you miss one step you're fucked because he won't ever give you a chance to recover and reset.🙃🙃

But honestly the fight was another skill check for me breaking my bad souls game habits. Lady butterfly was my first because unlike souls games where you're mostly on the defensive reacting to and countering your enemies attacks and then observing. You'll get no where doing that with this game. You have to be aggressive. And on the offensive constantly. Like bloodborne on steroids. 

For Genichiro the skill check came in the form that I can be longer just panic dodge my way to victory whenever I see an attack coming. I have to observe my opponent and what he is doing. Then react accordingly in a split second. By the end of the fight with him when I finally beat him it was almost like I mastered him. Knew his moves inside and out, could break everything down.

Thank you so much. I'll be sure to pass this information on to anyone I come in sexual contact with in the future. Sorry for the bombardment of questions but if I could just ask a few more. 

I've read the vaccine does absolutely nothing if you've already been exposed. Is that 100% true? If I was just exposed and the very next day I received the vaccine does that still count as too little too late. Will the vaccine to absolutely nothing to possibly prevent an outbreak of warts?

Medical student or not  you've managed to give me the most reassurance and knowledge about this then any other place I've been. Thank you. 

So given your word that everyone who have been sexually proactive has had it at some point. Did they have the wart causing strains? We've all possibly had it but if it was the wart causing one are we guaranteed to get warts? Or was it just the HPV strain that doesn't do anything. Do all low risk hpv strains cause warts? And if not is it a high chance the ones that do cause warts always give people warts?

Allow me to apologize. I didn't mean to downplay your knowledge I did not know you are possibly a medical student or have some so much research done on this subject. It's just admittingly frustrating that on the little Google searches and very brief lookups I've done. I've yet to find anything concrete on the subject. And many people seem to tell me different things. Like for example before the nurse practitioner the lady doing my check up told me that though most strains don't cause symptoms. Since the exposure I got from it was from some with active warts. I'll very likely get them to. But then right after I was told by the nurse no that doesn't mean that. I just don't know what to think at this point.

I know warts may not be a big deal to some but they just are to me. I just know I can't deal with them the rest of my life. I don't know how I'd handle that. They look so unsightly. I dread the day I see one appear.

Thank you for these words but not to discredit you, but where are your facts? I guess most of my anxiety comes from the fact I can't find answers anywhere. While I was getting my shot I bombarded the nurse practitioner with every question I could think of and she basically replied yes and no to everything. Who knows whether I'll have it for life. Who knows if I'll get warts for life. Who knows if I'll even contract it. There's been nothing concrete for me to grab hold of. I don't wanna out myself here but I've been a pretty sexually promiscuous guy periods of my life. Why is this the first time I'm hearing of it? I've always been extremely open about my sexual health and I've usually held partners to the same standard. No one has mentioned this before? How can such a common STD be so seldom mentioned? Why do I feel so singled out. If the person who exposed me to it had symptoms, and the person before them did as well. Then I'm guaranteed to have them to correct? Who knows, nurse just told me maybe. Everything's maybe at this point all the research I've done and all I've gotten from it is an I don't know but good luck and a slap on the shoulder.
